lookback_summary: Well, it was a mixed bag for the model this weekend! It correctly called the draw between Fulham and Man United, and also got it right with Man City's home win over Sunderland. However, it had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace match; despite predicting a home win, it ended in a draw. The model also stumbled on Everton's victory over Ipswich Town and missed the mark with Brighton's unexpected triumph over Arsenal. On the brighter side, it nailed the Newcastle win as a banker – a solid call there!
